entities.name: Nyambayaryn Tögstsogt
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tugstsogt Nyambayar is a Mongolian professional boxer who held the IBO featherweight title in 2019 and challenged for the WBC featherweight title in 2020. As an amateur, he won silver medals at the 2009 World Championships and 2012 London Olympics.
